You know trailing zeros in base 10. Base 12 has a twist. 🔄

When 2026! is written in base 12, how many zeros does it end with? Which prime runs out first, 2 or 3? IOQM / RMO-level number theory.

Comment your answer 👇 Solution tomorrow.

✅ Last answer: B, −x − 1.
Put x = ω (ω² + ω + 1 = 0, ω³ = 1). ω + 1 = −ω², so (ω + 1)²⁰²⁶ = ω⁴⁰⁵² = ω² = −ω − 1. The remainder ax + b must match: a = −1, b = −1.

Push a satellite from 2R to 3R. How much energy does it really take? 🛰️🌍

Mass m, circular orbits, R = Earth's radius, g at the surface. Minimum energy to shift orbits? Cheaper than you think! NSEP-level gravitation.

✅ Last answer: B, 0.30 m.
At maximum compression both blocks move together: 2 × 6 = 4v → v = 3 m/s. KE falls from 36 J to 18 J, so the spring stores 18 J = ½ × 400 × x² → x = 0.30 m.

Ksp(AgCl) = 1.8 × 10⁻¹⁰, Ksp(Ag₂CrO₄) = 1.1 × 10⁻¹². Which is more soluble in pure water, and in 0.01 M AgNO₃? NSEC-level ionic equilibrium.

✅ Last answer: D, 0.67.
Vapour density of PCl₅ = 208.5/2 = 104.25. Moles become 1 + α, so D/d = 1 + α → α = (104.25 − 62.55)/62.55 = 2/3 ≈ 0.67.
